# KJ Management Accounting Solutions

> KJ Management Accounting Solutions is a UK-based management accounting practice giving small business owners a complete finance function: management accounting, cash flow planning, budgeting and forecasting, financial modelling, annual accounts, bookkeeping, and virtual financial controller support. Founded by Kieran Johnston and Elaine Bryson, both Chartered Accountants (ACCA & ICAS) and a Xero Partner practice.

Serves small businesses across the UK and internationally, working remotely via Xero, QuickBooks and Google Workspace. Based in South Lanarkshire, Scotland, with a client base concentrated around Glasgow, Uddingston, and South and North Lanarkshire.

## Services

- [Management Accounting](https://kjmanagementaccountingsolutions.com/services#management): Monthly management accounts that show what happened in the business and what to do about it.
- [Annual Accounts](https://kjmanagementaccountingsolutions.com/services#annual): Year-end accounts prepared and filed with Companies House and HMRC.
- [Cash Flow Planning](https://kjmanagementaccountingsolutions.com/services#cash): Rolling cash flow forecasts to see what's coming before money gets tight.
- [Budgeting & Forecasting](https://kjmanagementaccountingsolutions.com/services#budgeting): Budgets with variance reporting showing where plan and reality diverge.
- [Financial Modelling for Investment](https://kjmanagementaccountingsolutions.com/services#financial): Investor-ready financial models and projections for lenders and funders.
- [Bookkeeping](https://kjmanagementaccountingsolutions.com/services#bookkeeping): Accurate, reconciled books kept current in Xero.
- [Virtual Financial Controller](https://kjmanagementaccountingsolutions.com/services#virtual): Senior part-time finance leadership without the cost of an in-house hire.
